name: @pipeworx/mcp-api-football

tools.name: fixtures
tools.description: Get match fixtures (upcoming + recent) by league, team, or date. Use league=1 for FIFA World Cup, league=39 for EPL, league=140 for La Liga. Returns kickoff, teams, score (if played), venue, status.

league.description: League ID (1 = FIFA World Cup, 39 = EPL, 140 = La Liga, 2 = Champions League — use league_search to find others)

team.description: Team ID — use team_search to find

last.description: Last N played matches for the team/league

next.description: Next N upcoming matches for the team/league

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Current standings table for a league. Returns rank, team, points, goal difference, form. Use league=1 for World Cup.

tools.name: team_search
tools.description: Look up a team by name + country to get its team_id for use in other tools.

tools.name: league_search
tools.description: Look up a league/tournament/competition by name to get its league_id.

tools.name: predictions
tools.description: API-Football's own match-outcome predictions. Returns home/draw/away win probabilities, advice, h2h context, form. Use for "who will win" research on specific fixtures.

fixture.description: Fixture ID — get from fixtures() output

tools.name: football_injuries
tools.description: Currently injured and unavailable football players for a club or a league — who is out, the injury or reason, and whether they are ruled out or merely doubtful. Covers Serie A, the Premier League, La Liga, the Bundesliga, Ligue 1 and other competitions worldwide. Use for questions about which players are injured, unavailable, or missing from a squad.

team.description: Club name, e.g. "AC Milan". Resolved to its team id for you.

league.description: League id instead of a team — use league_search to find one.

season.description: Season start year, e.g. 2025. Defaults to the current season.

tools.name: football_squad
tools.description: The current player squad for a football club — every player with shirt number, position, age and nationality. Use for questions about who plays for a club, squad lists, and a team roster.

team.description: Club name, e.g. "AC Milan". Resolved to its team id for you.

tools.name: h2h
tools.description: Head-to-head record between two teams. Returns last N matches with scores.

tools.name: api_football_status
tools.description: API-Football account status for the key in use: subscription plan name, whether it is active and when it ends, requests used today against the daily limit, and the per-minute limit the vendor reports in its rate-limit headers. The vendor does not count this call against the quota. Use it to tell a rate-limit answer from an exhausted plan. Account name and email are deliberately not returned.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-api-football forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the api-football pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
